description: A Digital Fine-Art & Frontend Creativity Challenge Organised by: Alankaar — Fine Arts Forum, BBD University Date: 9 October 2026 Venue: BBD University, Lucknow Duration: 6–7 Hours Team Size: 1–2 Participants Format: Single-Round On-Spot Creative Challenge About the Event Pixel Persona is an interdisciplinary creative challenge that brings together Fine Arts, Digital Design, UI/UX, Visual Storytelling and Frontend Development . Participants will be given a theme and problem statement on the spot and will have to transform their interpretation into an engaging digital experience using their creativity, design thinking and frontend skills. This is not just about writing code — it is about how you think, how you create and how you tell a story through pixels. Theme — Beyond the Frame Participants will explore the idea of going beyond conventional boundaries — physical, emotional, cultural, psychological, technological or imaginative. Problem Statement: "The world we experience is often limited by the frames we create. Break one such frame and express what lies beyond it through an interactive digital experience." There is no single correct interpretation . Your concept, artistic direction and originality define your creation. Event flow Registration & Briefing On-Spot Theme & Problem Statement Reveal Ideation & Concept Development Design & Frontend Development Final Submission Jury Showcase & Presentation Judging Criteria Creativity & Originality — 30% Art Direction & Visual Aesthetics — 25% Conceptual Depth & Storytelling — 20% Interaction & User Experience — 15% Technical Execution — 10% Participation Guidelines join the group : https://chat.whatsapp.com/JZC8llbtxddIF3PtfpRonh Team size: 1–2 participants Single-round competition Theme will be revealed on the spot Final work must be substantially created during the event Originality and creative interpretation are highly encouraged Pre-built templates or direct copying of existing designs are not permitted Participants

raw.details:
A Digital Fine-Art & Frontend Creativity Challenge

  • Organised by: Alankaar — Fine Arts Forum, BBD University
  • Date: 9 October 2026
  • Venue: BBD University, Lucknow
  • Duration: 6–7 Hours
  • Team Size: 1–2 Participants
  • Format: Single-Round On-Spot Creative Challenge

About the Event

Pixel Persona is an interdisciplinary creative challenge that brings together Fine Arts, Digital Design, UI/UX, Visual Storytelling and Frontend Development.

Participants will be given a theme and problem statement on the spot and will have to transform their interpretation into an engaging digital experience using their creativity, design thinking and frontend skills.

This is not just about writing code — it is about how you think, how you create and how you tell a story through pixels.

Theme — Beyond the Frame

Participants will explore the idea of going beyond conventional boundaries — physical, emotional, cultural, psychological, technological or imaginative.

Problem Statement:

"The world we experience is often limited by the frames we create. Break one such frame and express what lies beyond it through an interactive digital experience."

There is no single correct interpretation. Your concept, artistic direction and originality define your creation.

Event flow

  • Registration & Briefing
  • On-Spot Theme & Problem Statement Reveal
  • Ideation & Concept Development
  • Design & Frontend Development
  • Final Submission
  • Jury Showcase & Presentation

Judging Criteria

  • Creativity & Originality — 30%
  • Art Direction & Visual Aesthetics — 25%
  • Conceptual Depth & Storytelling — 20%
  • Interaction & User Experience — 15%
  • Technical Execution — 10%

Participation Guidelines
join the group : https://chat.whatsapp.com/JZC8llbtxddIF3PtfpRonh

  • Team size: 1–2 participants
  • Single-round competition
  • Theme will be revealed on the spot
  • Final work must be substantially created during the event
  • Originality and creative interpretation are highly encouraged
  • Pre-built templates or direct copying of existing designs are not permitted
  • Participants may use permitted frontend technologies, design tools and external libraries
  • Each team will present and explain their concept to the jury
